name: 婴幼儿温和嫩肤沐浴露款
description: 弱酸温和不刺激、绵密泡沫深层洁净、植物洗沐合一滋养嫩肤

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white rounded cards #FFFFFF floating on pale sage green #E9EDCB backdrops, soft matte pedestals, low-contrast layered panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, subtle reflections, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white pedestal #FFFFFF and pale sage matte board #E9EDCB
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, orange headlines with charcoal labels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in olive green #A9B276 inside thin circle outlines
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent pump-bottle scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout, product always fully lit and grounded with a contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent gentle baby-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale sage green #E9EDCB, charcoal text #3A3F3A, one warm orange accent #F08519 and one olive green secondary accent #A9B276; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines only; consistent white rounded cards and rounded label chips; consistent thin-line icon style inside thin circle outlines; clean soft product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent pump-bottle scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Centered straight-on eye-level view of the upright pump bottle, full product visible, standing on a low matte white pedestal. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, pedestal and contact shadow completing one clean compliant main-image composition. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 源图为一张 8000px 级详情长图（切 7 片分析），主产品为婴儿沐浴露（奶黄泵瓶 350ml），与源文件夹名一致。已剥离素材站水印（瓶身 DW 字样）、模板品牌示意文字及规格卡填充文案（原文写的是沐浴洗发水300g，与图中产品不符，未采信）；婴儿模特脸以背身/手部框架泛化处理；香型名、品牌承诺均改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 占位。痛点与对比两类源图缺失，套件按情感价值驱动编排，收口用 TRUST。
